clippings.speaker: Samuel L. Jackson
clippings.quote: He told me, ‘Hopefully you’ll be able to find a character that, when you make bad movies and they don’t make any money, you can always go back to this character everybody loves,” … “He said, ‘Arnold’s got Terminator. Sylvester’s got Rocky and Rambo. I’ve got John McClane.’ I’m like, ‘Oh, okay,’” … “And it didn’t occur to me until I got that Nick Fury role — and I had a nine-picture deal to be Nick Fury — that, ‘Oh, I’m doing what Bruce said,”
clippings.title: Samuel L. Jackson Shares The Honest Advice Bruce Willis Gave Him About Movies
clippings.context: Jackson recalling advice Willis gave him on the Die Hard With a Vengeance set, from a Vanity Fair tribute for Willis' 70th birthday, as reported by HuffPost.

clippings.speaker: Samuel L. Jackson
clippings.quote: Bruce and I have been around together for quite a bit, so… it was kind of easy for us to kind of listen to Night and look at each other and go, “ Yeah , wait till this kid finds out.”
clippings.title: An Oral History of Unbreakable With M. Night Shyamalan and Samuel L. Jackson
clippings.context: Jackson on how he and Willis, as veterans, handled the young Shyamalan's line readings on Unbreakable.

clippings.speaker: Samuel L. Jackson
clippings.quote: It looked kind of like Bruce, but Bruce hadn't started shaving his head yet and this guy had no hair,” … “I was like, "Hmm, could it be?" Then I heard his voice and said, 'It is Bruce.'" … "And Bruce went, 'Sam, there's this guy who's writing a script for us.'
clippings.title: A Chance Meeting Between Bruce Willis And Samuel L. Jackson Set The Stage For Unbreakable
clippings.context: Jackson recalling running into Willis in a Moroccan casino, which led to Unbreakable; from EW's 15th-anniversary oral history, quoted by SlashFilm.

clippings.speaker: Bruce Willis
clippings.quote: I was in a casino in Marrakech, in Morocco, and I saw this guy and I said, 'Somebody over there is trying to impersonate Sam Jackson.'
clippings.title: A Chance Meeting Between Bruce Willis And Samuel L. Jackson Set The Stage For Unbreakable
clippings.context: Willis's side of the chance casino meeting that put Jackson in Unbreakable; from EW's oral history, quoted by SlashFilm.

clippings.speaker: Bruce Willis
clippings.quote: I talked to [Shyamalan] over the holidays, and he is still thinking about doing the fight movie between me and Sam that we were going to do.
clippings.title: Bruce Willis says M. Night Shyamalan ‘Still Thinking’ About ‘Unbreakable 2’
clippings.context: Willis to MTV News on a possible Unbreakable sequel pitting his hero against Jackson's villain; reposted by a fan site.

clippings.speaker: Bruce Willis
clippings.quote: As long as Sam can make it, I’m up for it.
clippings.title: Bruce Willis says M. Night Shyamalan ‘Still Thinking’ About ‘Unbreakable 2’
clippings.context: Willis to MTV News, conditioning an Unbreakable sequel on Jackson's availability; reposted by a fan site.
